source_title: piermark/omarchytv: Omarchy-styled tiling launcher ecosystem for Android TV, Google TV, LG webOS, Android Mobile & Linux/macOS/Omarchy PCs - GitHub
source_excerpt:
An Omarchy-style home screen for Android TV, featuring a native Omarchy TUI Grok Bot assistant, 32 MIT themes with TV wallpapers, a desktop link to your Omarchy PC / Mac, a native MCP server, and an Android smartphone wireless installer.
Created by Marco Porro ( x.com/MarcoPorro · www.marcoporro.it )
Official Synchronized Repositories: GitHub ( github.com/piermark/omarchytv ) · GitLab ( gitlab.com/piermark/omarchytv )
Published: 31 October 2026 (latest release) · Version 2.13.8 ( versionCode 25 — Android TV, PC/Mac Plugin & Mobile Companion) / 2.13.9 (LG webOS) & 2.13.9 (Samsung Tizen), experimental · Cinemarchy 0.1.0-alpha · License MIT
Beta software. Tested on Sony BRAVIA (Android 9), Google TV Streamer (Android 14), Sharp AQUOS, Noblex/Hisense (Android 11), LG webOS and the Android TV emulator. Some features may be missing on some TVs. It never roots or uninstalls anything, and you can always switch back to your stock home screen (see INSTALL ).
OmarchyTV 2.13.8 on my Sony BRAVIA: Tom Ballard's ( @tcballard ) Tokyo Roadster theme and wallpaper (MIT, see Credits ), Grok Bot companion and the SpaceX TV plugin by Simon Loffler ( @sighmon ).
Animated wallpapers come alive when you open the launcher or press Home (artwork and animations by Erik Johansson , MIT). Click a frame to play the clip:
Screenshots from the Android TV emulator (API 28, 1920×1080, English UI). The app tiles (Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube, CHILI, RaiPlay) are the real app icons captured on a Sony KD-55XE9005 running OmarchyTV; see Trademarks .
Release Downloads & Checksums ( v2.13.0-beta , pre-release)
I sign every Android APK with the OmarchyTV release certificate ( SHA-256: 90aa68d9f45e623eadfd349ab1eb66042356f95ff6347a4568c3f3a78f8ea33d ), so adb install -r upgrades over 2.12.0-beta and keeps your settings. All checksums are also in SHA256SUMS on the release.
All releases are on GitHub Releases and GitLab Releases . Full notes: CHANGELOG.md . Previous release: v2.12.0-beta .

What's New in 2.13.2-testing (LG webOS) / 2.13.6-testing (Samsung Tizen)
One shared web app, two version numbers: the Samsung widget is numbered 2.13.6 so it installs over the earlier 2.13.5 test widget. Release: GitHub · GitLab .
Bigger text on LG webOS and Samsung Tizen: launcher text can now be enlarged on both TVs from Settings > System > Text size : Small 90%, Normal 100% (default), Large 115% and Extra large 130%. It applies to the whole launcher, it is saved across restarts, and it is translated in English, Italian and German.
Crisp Cinemarchy and OMARCHY logos: the block-art logos are now drawn as vector graphics, so they stay sharp at 1080p and 720p.
Lighter screensaver on Samsung: on Tizen the Aquarium renders at half resolution (it still fills the screen), thanks to the first Samsung test by Wes (@wesleygrimes, #60). webOS stays at full resolution.
Samsung Tizen improvements by @fraction12 (#61): installed-app discovery with native artwork, and real TV/HDMI source switching.
Smoother Aquarium screensaver by @jdtimothy: fewer pauses and audio dropouts, fixed End Credits (#62), and the ducks no longer teleport (#63).
What's New in 2.13.0-beta ( versionCode 21 , pre-release)
Default Aquarium screensaver: "asciiquarium × Second Reality" homage + 4-channel tracker audio: the default screensaver ( saverArt = "aquarium" , sound on by default, M toggles mute) is now a small demo in five parts that loop: Surface (ship with OMARCHY on the hull, whale and spout, ducks), Descent , Mid waters (porthole lens, copper bars, the moving OMARCHY castle), Abyss (translucent glenz vector, angler fish, leviathan) and an end credits scroller with greetz. Many fish species swim in depth lanes with parallax, fish breathe bubbles, and a shark eats fish. The depth header and the right ruler show the same depth. The palette comes from the current Omarchy theme. Audio is my own 4-channel tracker-style tune at 48 kHz stereo, with tracker panning (L R R L), click-free envelopes, per-part variations, an ambient abyss, and VU meters fed by the real channel levels. For burn-in, the whole picture shifts a few pixels slowly, the HUD fades in and out, and nothing stays still. Rendering is capped at 30 fps.

Aquarium Classic: the previous Cyber-TUI Aquarium, with its look and its original ST3 tune, is still available as Aquarium Classic ( saverArt = "aquarium-classic" ) in the screensaver picker on Android TV, webOS and Tizen. I only fixed its bugs: full OMARCHY logo, no overlapping text (the ST3 line has its own row; ticker, copper bar and scroller no longer collide), dim sonar column behind the fish, and anti burn-in pixel shift + HUD fade. A personal homage: I made the ASCII Aquarium as my personal homage to the 1990s demoscene and to Future Crew's Second Reality (1993). All of the code, graphics and audio are original. Nothing was taken from their demo. The fish-tank idea is inspired by asciiquarium by Kirk Baucom (GPL); no code or art from it was copied, every sprite was drawn from scratch. — Marco Porro

Sandboxed Plugin Engine ( SpaceX TV by @sighmon & Grok Bot Companion by @tcballard ): Manage declarative JSON plugins from Settings → Plugins or omarchy-tv plugins , featuring the SpaceX TV top-bar launch pill (based on @sighmon 's MIT Omarchy plugin omarchy-spacex-tv ) and the Grok Bot companion named after Tom Ballard's ( @tcballard ) MIT omarchy-plugin-grokbot-desktop with blinking capsule eyes ( [ ◉ ◉ ] ). omarchy-tv plugins catalog [QUERY] browses the official Omarchy desktop registry ( plugins.omarchy.org/catalog.json ). By default only TV-relevant entries are shown (media and visual tags such as themes, wallpapers, screensavers, ambience, or a TV manifest); desktop-only bar/shell/quickshell plugins are hidden ( --all shows them). It is browse-only: each entry shows its repo and PC install command; only plugins that also have an OmarchyTV TV manifest are installable on the TV ( TV ✓ ).

Cinemarchy @dhh37, YouTube embed and the TV companion (2.13.0-beta)
@dhh37: I read DHH's public uploads feed every 6 h (and on open), cache it, merge it with a curated list and mark new videos NEW . Only links and metadata; nothing is downloaded.
Play inside Cinemarchy (off by default): the official YouTube IFrame embed with chapter jumps. If YouTube refuses the embed, I open the YouTube app.
Grok Bot, the default assistant (built on Tom Ballard's Grok Bot Desktop Companion v0.1.0, MIT, thank you Tom!): a floating bot in a corner of the home screen. webOS/Tizen: it draws Tom's 14 shapes, palette and eyes. It bobs, blinks, looks around, sleeps and drifts to avoid burn-in. Blue opens the chat, holding Blue opens it by voice, and on Tizen the voice/Search key does too when the TV allows it. Android: it now draws Tom's 14 shapes, 11 colours and eyes too, with the same bob, blink, glance, sleep and drift, an unread dot, and the same Settings → Grok Bot options (shape, colour, size, name badge, animation, agent). The Blue key opens the chat (thanks, @andersonleite, #65), the mic/Search key opens it by voice, and long-press Menu, then OK, also works. Answers: they come from the Grok Bot on your PC: through omarchy-link on Android, and through omarchy-tv webos serve with its ask code on webOS/Tizen. Otherwise, Android uses Ask with your chosen AI provider and webOS/Tizen uses grok.com. Also: "open Netflix" / "apri YouTube" opens apps on the TV. Links in a reply become OK-to-play buttons. Grok Bot · Omarchy TUI on LG/Samsung (new in 2.13.9 ): the Android TUI window now runs on webOS and Tizen too: Menu > ⌨ Grok Bot (Omarchy TUI). It switches themes, wallpapers, screensavers and their speed, opens apps and web apps (grok.com, ChatGPT, Claude, Hermes), and asks the same agents as Android: Grok Bot, the AIs signed in on your PC (Claude, Codex, Grok, Hermes, Gemini, ollama…) or Grok Bot diretto. Also new: Menu > Grok Bot & AI, Menu > Web apps, companion offset, and LG app icons now stay after a theme change. Details in INSTALL-WEBOS.md . What the platforms allow: the webOS Magic Remote mic always goes to webOS. On Android, Google Assistant stays one setting away ( "voiceKey": "assistant" ).

What's New in 2.12.0-beta ( versionCode 20 )
Native Grok Bot · Omarchy TUI ( AskActivity ) on the TV Home Shelf: Clicking the Grok Bot tile ( grokbot@tv:~$ > GROK BOT [ omarchy · tui ] ) on the TV Home shelf — or selecting Grok Bot (Omarchy TUI) in the menu — opens a native Omarchy-styled TUI assistant window ( BoxView 2 px border, btop -style legend grok bot · omarchy tui [ ] , translucent theme surface over the live 4K WallpaperView , CaskaydiaMono font, and grokbot@omarchytv:~$ prompt) instead of jumping straight into a raw web browser. Standalone Local TV & MCP Control (works offline without a PC): Switch any of the 32 MIT themes ( theme jade-horse , theme year-of-the-horse , theme hermarchy , next theme , themes ), cycle 4K wallpapers ( wallpaper ), launch or configure the 37 tte.js ASCII screensavers ( screensaver , speed slow|normal|fast ), launch installed TV apps or Live TV ( open YouTube , open TV , apps ), or inspect TV/network/MCP status ( status , mcp ) via voice, keyboard, or 1-click D-pad quick chips ( [ ⏭ next theme ] , [ 🖼 wallpaper ] , [ ✦ screensaver ] , [ 📊 status ] , [ 📦 apps ] , [ ❓ help ] ). Paired PC / Mac AI Bridge ( OmarchyLink ): Automatically forwards open-ended AI questions over the authenticated LAN link (Omarchy Link) to your already-authenticated PC/Mac CLI ( grok , claude , codex , gemini , hermes , or local ollama ) and streams the reply typewriter-style in the TUI terminal. Optional 1-Click Full Browser WebApp Mode ( [ 🌐 grok.com ] / [ 🌐 web ▾ ] ): Whenever you want the full web interface, select [ 🌐 grok.com ] or [ 🌐 web ▾ ] inside the TUI header (or from > Grok Bot & AI ) to open Grok Web ( grok.com ), Grok (X) ( x.com/i/grok ), ChatGPT ( chatgpt.com ), Claude ( claude.ai ), or Hermes ( hermes.nousresearch.com ) in the sandboxed :web process ( WebAppActivity ) with persistent cookies/DOM storage and D-pad cursor.
